summary: York Suburban School District argues that eliminating or reducing federal E‑Rate subsidies would force the district to absorb essential internet infrastructure costs, threatening funding for academic programs and staff.

claims.argument: If federal E‑Rate subsidies are eliminated or reduced, the district will be forced to fully absorb vital technology costs locally, threatening funding for academic programs and staff.
claims.evidence_quote: and special education. If federal E-Rate subsidies for essential internet infrastructure are eliminated or reduced, York Suburban will be forced to fully absorb these vital technology costs locally.
